landing.greetingMsg1: They say life’s greatest adventures are meant to be shared.
landing.greetingMsg2: After years of navigating the world as a duo, we’re officially upgrading to a lifelong partnership. We are honored to have you join us as we exchange our 'I do’s' and celebrate the start of our best chapter yet.
landing.weddingRightNowMsg: Wedding is happening right now! Let’s party!
landing.address2: Ciao Tou Sugar Refinery, Kaohsiung City, Taiwan
landing.attireGuideMsg: Dress Code: <1>Semi-formal, think spring vibes and earthy tones!</1>  Basically, look like a stylish forest! Please choose comfortable shoes that won't betray you on the dance floor and are ready for a marathon of celebration. If your feet are happy, we’re happy.
landing.rsvpMsg: Final boarding call! Please RSVP by February 28th, 2026, to secure your spot for our biggest adventure yet. We’ve got a seat (and a drink) with your name on it, see you on the dance floor!
landing.footerMsg: Thanks for keeping us sane and being our favorite humans. The paperwork and planning are finally done—now we just need you to show up, help us make some memories, and witness our questionable dance moves. Let’s see how much we actually remember the next day!

notFound.title: Oops...
notFound.message: You have wondered into a mysterious corner of the internet. Maybe our wedding cake is hiding here?

transportation.title: The 'How to Find Us' Guide (Don't Get Lost!)
transportation.content:
1. <1>Metro</1>: Take the Red Line to <2>Ciaotou Station (R23)</2>. Warning: The 'Ciaotou Sugar Refinery(R22A)' is a total trap! Don't fall for it unless you enjoy a 15-minute accidental hike. 

2. <1>Driving</1>: Set your navigation to <3>R23 Sugar Warehouse Convention Center Parking lot</3>. However, if you plan on clinking glasses with us, please leave the car at home. We’d much rather see you alive and well tomorrow! 

3. <1>Taxi/Uber</1>: Set destination to <3>R23 Sugar Warehouse Convention Center Parking lot</3>. Pro-tip: Pre-book your ride home, otherwise the local mosquitoes will be your only company while you wait for a car in the middle of the night.

accommodation.title: The 'Where to Crash' Situation
accommodation.content: As much as we love the warehouse vibe, sleeping on the floor isn't an option. Since there are no hotels next door, we suggest staying near the <1>'Kaohsiung Arena Station'(R14)</1> (Ju Dan). It’s a foodie paradise and only 30 minutes away from the party!

childrenPolicy.title: A Mandatory Night Off for Parents
childrenPolicy.content: We love your little ones, but we’ve decided to host an 'Adults-Only' celebration. Consider this your official excuse to drop the baby bottles, pick up a cocktail, and enjoy a night of zero screaming—except, of course, for the shouting on the dance floor!

rsvp.title: RSVP
rsvp.content: Organizing the seating chart is like a high-stakes game of Tetris. To keep us from crashing, please reply by <1>February 28th</1>. As seats are limited to the exact person, we unfortunately cannot accommodate 'surprise guests' (+1). If you can't make it, let us know early—otherwise, we’ll be stalking your Instagram stories to see what you were doing instead!

punctuality.title: Early Birds Get the Booze!
punctuality.content: The 'I Dos' start at 4:00 PM sharp. We recommend arriving by 3:45 PM to snag a seat and a drink. Latecomers who sneak in during the ceremony might be asked to perform a solo dance on stage—you’ve been warned!

loveStory.content: Two Taipei newbies exploring night markets and the city. Turns out, we were the best find on the menu.
Globetrotting with the crew! After surviving long flights and shared suitcases, we knew this was for real.
A deep dive in the Maldives! We went down for the Whale sharks, but came up with a ring and a fiancé(e).
